#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the Project Kickoff meeting."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date

# Determine "next Monday" (the first Monday strictly after today)
today = date.today()
days_until_monday = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_until_monday == 0:
    days_until_monday = 7  # if today is Monday, use the following Monday
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_monday)

start_date = next_monday
start_time = "100000"  # 10:00 AM local time
end_time = "120000"    # 12:00 PM local time (2-hour duration)

dtstamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"

ics_content = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Workspace//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART:{start_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T{start_time}
DTEND:{start_date.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T{end_time}
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the project. Agenda: project overview, goals, roles and responsibilities, timeline, and next steps.
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

print(f"Created project_kickoff.ics")
print(f"  Date: {next_monday.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")
print(f"  Time: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM (local, floating time)")
print(f"  UID:  {uid}")
